title: One subject's observations
description: What was found about one stack, one entry per dimension. Every dimension must be answered or explicitly marked not evaluated; there is no third state.

stack.description: Must match a stack id in stacks.json, and the file's own basename.

notEvaluated.title: An explicit omission
notEvaluated.description: Absence is never ambiguous: a dimension nobody looked at says so, with a reason.

not_evaluated.description: Why it was not evaluated. An omission with no reason reads as a finding.

confidence.description: The confidence ladder. generated is computed from this repository at render time and is restricted to the is_self stack; measured is re-derivable by the reproduce command at the pinned version; documented is the subject's own published material; assessed is reviewer judgment and must carry a rationale.

summary.description: The finding, in one table cell. On a generated cell, every computed value appears as a {rule} placeholder and is substituted at render time — it is never typed.

path.description: A path in this repository. Must exist.

evidence.description: At least one entry, each pointing at something that can stop being true.

version_evaluated.description: The tag, release or version the observation was taken at. Without it the claim has no subject.

evaluated_at.description: ISO date. Past the age limit the check fails and names the refresh command.

reproduce.description: Required by the measured tier: a command that re-derives the finding from the subject at version_evaluated.

rationale.description: Required by the assessed tier: what the judgment rests on, so a reader can disagree with it.

generated_from.description: Required by, and restricted to, the generated tier. Each rule is recomputed at render time and substituted into the summary's matching placeholder.
